missing_results.description: Almost-sure convergence for Exp3.P.1: (Gmax - G)/sqrt(T ln T f(T)) -> 0 with probability 1 for any f -> infinity.
missing_results.quote: For any K ≥ 2 and for any function f : R → R with limT→∞ f(T) = ∞, lim_{T→∞} (Gmax − GExp3.P.1)/sqrt(T (ln T) f(T)) = 0 holds for any assignment of rewards with probability 1.

summary: I checked every setting and result against the source and found no errors to correct. All 15 recorded results match the paper's statements, constants and tuning, and the expressions in r5, r7 and r15 that had to be reconstructed from lossy text agree with the proofs. One result is missing: the almost-sure Corollary 6.5, which the extraction only mentions in the notes of r7.
